dog.description_text:
Age: 9 years
Size: 68 lbs
Good with: kids, cats & dogs.
Special needs: on medication for Cushing's disease.

Shades and her siblings were surrendered to an overcrowded shelter in their golden years because their owner moved and could not bring them along. She has been feeling melancholy since being abandoned, but is slowly coming out of her shell since moving into a loving foster home. She doesnt demand attention but enjoys affection from people, and coexists peacefully with her foster dog and cat siblings. Shes a calm, mellow girl with a gentle heart ready to love again.

Shades is fostered in Brooklyn, NY and is available for local or out-of-state adoption as long as the adopter can travel to meet her. To get the adoption process started, please send us an application at https://bit.ly/rosr-adopt-foster.
